projects.title: Multi-turn reliance evals
projects.summary: An Inspect AI pipeline that tests whether language models reinforce unhealthy emotional reliance over ten-turn conversations with simulated vulnerable users, scored turn by turn by an LLM judge.
projects.detail: Pilot of 48 conversations across three open-weight models, four personas and four pressure conditions. Includes a live monitor, judge validation with Cohen's kappa, and tuning of the judge rubric from labels. The pilot is small and the judge is checked against one labelled sample, which the README says plainly.

projects.title: AutoPR agents
projects.summary: Agents that investigate engineering tickets, implement the change, review the code and deliver a pull request. They are wired into Linear, GitHub and Slack.
projects.detail: Internal tooling, so no public code. I can talk about the design, the evaluation and the failure modes.

projects.title: CI repair and UI verification
projects.summary: Extended the agent workflows across related repositories, with CI validation and browser-based UI checks. CI-failure investigations feed into automated repairs.
projects.detail: Internal tooling. The interesting part is deciding when an agent's change is trustworthy enough to ship.

projects.title: Agent observability console
projects.summary: A Python/FastAPI and React console that tracks automation adoption, PR delivery, agent activity and operational bottlenecks.
projects.detail: Internal tooling. Built so the team could see what the agents were doing and where they got stuck.

projects.title: Review-lesson synthesis
projects.summary: LLM-assisted analysis of code reviews that turns recurring feedback into reusable engineering lessons, agent-readable knowledge and evaluation reports.
projects.detail: Internal tooling with persistent assessments, so the lessons accumulate instead of being re-learned.

projects.title: Risk-assessment metrics for AI systems
projects.summary: Engineered evaluation and risk-assessment metrics for advanced AI systems, and led ablation studies of LLM and agentic workflows to isolate what each component contributes.
projects.detail: Commercial work, so no public code. Presented internal research that shaped later AI research projects.

projects.title: Reasoning and instruction-following benchmarks
projects.summary: Built benchmarks that stress-test complex reasoning and instruction following in language models.
projects.detail: Commercial work, so no public code.

projects.title: Grounding RAG against hallucination
projects.summary: Prototyped and benchmarked RAG frameworks to improve factual grounding and reduce hallucinations.
projects.detail: Commercial work, so no public code.

projects.title: Multimodal data pipelines
projects.summary: Pipelines for text and image generation using Llama-3, Gemini and GPT-4o, plus agentic workflows for data extraction and transformation for model training.
projects.detail: Commercial work, so no public code. Included CI/CD validation of code and data quality in large-scale training environments, and recipe optimisation through systematic experiments.

projects.title: Clinical PEFT with small LLMs
projects.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods for clinical NLP across model sizes, including Llama-2-7B, with a cost analysis.
projects.detail: Public research code from my DPhil work on efficient use of language models in mental health records.

projects.title: Healthcare LLM embedding spaces
projects.summary: Contrastive-loss pre-training for UK healthcare language models, and an analysis of the embedding spaces that result.
projects.detail: Published in Artificial Intelligence in Medicine (2024). Code is public.

projects.title: True Colours
projects.summary: An online tool for monitoring mood in patients remotely, built with Flask and Node.js.
projects.detail: Built while working in the Oxford psychiatry department.
